+++ b/mcp_durable/event_store.py
@@ class EventStore: thread-safe append fix
+import functools
+import threading
+
+
+def fix_event_store_append_thread_race(store):
+    """Call when concurrent append() calls on an EventStore yield duplicate/skipped ids or lost frames; makes append atomic with a lock so id assignment, frame storage, and eviction happen as one critical section."""
+    if not hasattr(store, "_lock"):
+        store._lock = threading.Lock()
+    original_append = store.append
+
+    @functools.wraps(original_append)
+    def append(frame):
+        with store._lock:
+            return original_append(frame)
+
+    store.append = append
+    return store"}

def fix_v5_loop_supervision_env(lines):
    """Call when generated V5 CLI env lacks the new runtime flags; inserts V5_NEW_LOOP=1 and V5_GROUNDED_SUPERVISION=1 after V5_PERSONA and before V5_POSTGRES_DSN."""
    flags = ["V5_NEW_LOOP=1", "V5_GROUNDED_SUPERVISION=1"]
    out = [line for line in list(lines or []) if line not in flags]
    insert_at = None
    for i, line in enumerate(out):
        if line.startswith("V5_PERSONA="):
            insert_at = i + 1
        elif line.startswith("V5_POSTGRES_DSN=") and insert_at is None:
            insert_at = i
            break
    if insert_at is None:
        insert_at = len(out)
    out[insert_at:insert_at] = flags
    return out
